name: Make silence count only where a test could detect the thing

uses.action: Hold the listening place and brass surface fixed. Check the spoon with the link fitted and removed, test the two covered catches and lift both cloths. A silent spoon gives information under those tested conditions. The old account cannot establish who was inside from silence alone.

name: Find whose choices have been built into a public map

uses.action: Produce four limited-layer maps of the same town and receive each reader’s response. Compare the guild’s named stall layer with a traveller’s landmarks and a well keeper’s surface evidence. Decide which document faces the street and where a caller must ask for another account.
